intro.text: A soldier who fought alongside the Knights Radiant in ancient times, seen in one of Dalinar's visions.

items.text: Caeb and Dalinar were among about a dozen soldiers escorting a female Radiant in red-accented Shardplate. Many of the soldiers glowed faintly with Stormlight, which surprised Dalinar.

Their team joined others searching the Purelake for a strange spren. Caeb was the first to glimpse it; Dalinar then found the red-eyed spren in the water, and a Radiant told Caeb to run back to the checkpoint.
